message: You know, when I was a kid, I thought my parents were just being dramatic about storms. Now that I'm a grandparent, I find myself doing the same thing! 😅 I came across a great resource about preparing for heat that reminded me how important it is to stay cool and calm when the weather gets a bit too intense. It’s funny how the roles reverse, isn’t it? What little things do you do to keep your family ready for the unexpected?
